jobs.description:
Riot is expanding into the Trading Card Game space with Riftbound, and we are looking for a Regional Publishing Product Lead - Riftbound to lead its launch and growth in Korea.
As the
Regional Publishing Product Lead
- Riftbound on Korea Publishing team, you will lead the team responsible for delivering Riftbound’s publishing strategy and player experience in the Korean market. You will translate global product and publishing direction into locally relevant plans, oversee marketing and community initiatives, and develop relationships with distributors, retailers, tournament organizers, and other external partners.
You will combine strong market knowledge with people leadership and operational discipline. You will be accountable for setting priorities, developing your team, coordinating across Riot and external partners, and delivering measurable player and business outcomes for Riftbound in Korea.
You will report to Sr. Director, General Management.
Responsibilities:
Korea Publishing Strategy & Team Management.
Develop and lead Riftbound’s Korea publishing strategy in alignment with global product and publishing objectives; Translate Korean player insights, cultural trends, and market dynamics into clear priorities and publishing plans; Oversee the execution of local marketing campaigns, community programs, competitive-play initiatives, and retail activations; Establish goals and success measures for the Korea market, and adjust plans based on performance and player feedback; Ensure local initiatives deliver a cohesive and culturally relevant Riftbound player experience; Manage, coach, and develop a team responsible for Riftbound publishing initiatives in Korea; Establish clear goals, roles, and ways of working that enable the team to operate effectively. Provide regular feedback, support career development, and foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment; Allocate team capacity and resources based on player needs, business priorities, and launch requirements; Identify capability or resourcing gaps and work with leadership to address them.
Cross-Functional Collaboration.
Serve as the primary Korea publishing partner for Riftbound’s global and regional teams; Represent Korean player, community, and partner needs in planning and decision-making forums; Partner with Riot’s global publishing, product, brand, esports, community, insights, finance, legal, and operations teams; Maintain alignment between global strategies and Korea-specific execution while advocating for necessary local adaptations; Collaborate with Korea leadership and publishing teams across the region to share insights and improve ways of working.
Player and Community Ecosystem.
Lead the development of Riftbound’s competitive, hobby-play, and community ecosystems in Korea; Guide programs that support player acquisition, engagement, retention, and long-term community health; Build relationships with tournament organizers, retailers, hobby stores, creators, and community leaders; Establish systems for gathering and acting on Korean player and partner feedback; Partner with global teams to ensure relevant market insights inform future product and publishing decisions.
Business and Partnership Management.
Manage Riftbound’s Korea publishing budget and ensure resources are allocated against the highest-impact priorities; Develop and oversee local partnership strategies involving distributors, retailers, media organizations, brands, and community partners; Set clear expectations and performance measures for external partners; Identify market risks, operational dependencies, and opportunities, and communicate them to relevant leaders; Partner with Insights and Finance teams to track adoption, engagement, retention, ecosystem health, and business performance.
Required Qualifications:
8+ years of experience in publishing, product management, marketing, or a related discipline within games, entertainment, consumer products, or another relevant industry;
2+ years of experience directly managing and developing teams.
Strong understanding of Korean consumer behavior, cultural trends, media channels, and gaming or entertainment audiences. Experience launching or growing products in the Korean market.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple internal teams and external partners.
Experience managing agencies, distributors, retailers, community organizations, or other commercial partners.
Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, manage budgets, and use performance data to guide decisions.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Fluency in Korean and English, both written and spoken.
Desired Qualifications:
Experience in tabletop games, trading card games, hobby entertainment, organized play, or competitive gaming; Existing relationships within Korea’s TCG, gaming, retail, creator, or hobby ecosystems.
Experience adapting global products, campaigns, or brands for the Korean market.
Experience managing teams through a product launch or period of rapid growth.
Familiarity with retail distribution, organized-play programs, inventory dependencies, or physical consumer products.
Ability to convert player and market insights into clear strategies and executable plans; Passion for tabletop and trading card games and empathy for Korean player communities.
Success in This Role:
Building and developing a high-performing Korea publishing team.
Delivering a coordinated and culturally relevant launch for Riftbound in Korea.
Establishing healthy competitive-play, hobby, retail, and community ecosystems.
Building productive relationships with global teams and local external partners.
Represent Korean players and market needs clearly and constructively.
Delivering measurable player, community, and business outcomes.
Creating sustainable operating plans that support Riftbound’s continued growth in Korea.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

회사 소개
쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.
쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.
대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.
보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.
팀 소개
쿠팡페이의 Fintech Business Development(사업개발)팀은 쿠팡 생태계의 고객들을 위해 카드/은행 등 다양한 금융사와의 제휴를 통해 신규 사업을 발굴하고 시도하며, 쿠팡의 고객에게 새로운 결제 경험을 제공합니다.
쿠팡을 이용하는 고객의 목소리에 항상 귀기울이고, 효율적인 서비스 운영을 위해 개선 포인트를 찾아 지속적으로 업무 프로세스를 간소화하고 개선합니다. 이러한 시도는 결제 영역에 국한되지 않으며, 고객과 쿠팡페이에 더 많은 가치를 창출해 줄 수 있는 새로운 사업과 전략적 과제들을 발굴하고 긴밀하게 유관 부서들과 협업하며 추진합니다.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the Role
The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running — we make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're seeking an IT Support Engineer who combines deep technical skills with a genuine service mindset and sound judgment.
Anthropic is growing fast, and our IT operations need to keep pace. That means onboarding at scale, automating repetitive processes (including with Claude), and continuously improving the employee experience. You'll handle support challenges across our primarily macOS environment while contributing to the operational improvements that help us scale. You'll work closely with IT Engineering and Security, with opportunities to grow into more technical infrastructure work over time.
Responsibilities
End-User Support
Triage and resolve issues across hardware, software, networking, and accounts — primarily through our ticketing system, with additional support via Slack and in-person
Diagnose and resolve issues across macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, and our core SaaS platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian)
Troubleshoot device issues, including enrollment, configuration profiles, and policy enforcement
Support access management and employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, reorgs)
Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination
Participate in an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours
Provide hands-on support for user technology, AV systems, conference rooms, and printers
Communication & Documentation
Communicate clearly with users of all technical levels
Write and maintain internal documentation including runbooks, how-to guides, and knowledge base articles
Identify patterns in support requests, surface recurring issues to the team, and identify opportunities for automation or systemic solves
Operational Improvement
Help streamline onboarding and other high-volume operations as the company scales
Contribute to automation efforts
Maintain and improve device management, identity, and access systems
Assist with scripting (Bash, Python) to automate repetitive tasks
You may be a good fit if you
Have 7+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally in a fast-paced or high-growth environment
Are an excellent communicator who genuinely enjoys helping people solve problems
Have strong troubleshooting skills and are methodical, curious, and persistent
Demonstrated experience supporting macOS endpoints and comfortable supporting ChromeOS, iOS, and Android
Have significant experience with Google Workspace administration
Have experience with Slack administration — workspace management, permissions, and troubleshooting
Have substantial experience supporting and administering additional SaaS tools
Understand identity and access fundamentals — SSO, MFA, directory services
Are familiar with MDM fundamentals and endpoint management concepts
Have experience with basic scripting (Bash or Python) for automation
Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved
Think beyond the immediate fix — you ask "why did this happen?" and "how do we prevent it?"
Are organized enough to manage competing priorities without things falling through the cracks
Propose solutions when you see a process that doesn't scale
Are looking to develop deeper technical skills and take on more complex systems administration challenges over time
Strong candidates may also
Be familiar with zero-trust security concepts and endpoint security tooling
Have experience with networking basics — DNS, DHCP, VPNs, networking fundamentals
Have contributed to IT projects beyond day-to-day support (migrations, tool rollouts, process redesigns)
Have experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity
Location
This role is based in our San Francisco, Seattle, New York or Washington DC office and there is a 4 day/week in office expectation.
What Makes This Role Unique
You'll be joining a high-impact IT team supporting some of the world's leading AI researchers and engineers. The pace is fast and you'll have real ownership over your work. This isn't a role where you follow rigid scripts — you'll be trusted to use your judgment, improve our processes, and grow with the team. Because we're scaling rapidly, you'll have meaningful opportunities to shape how IT operations work at Anthropic.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
